rec.name: PDP Video Play Button (Product Video Trigger)
rec.status: Built — A/B test set up in Ablyft (placeholder video used; result not documented)

what.text: A play button on the product detail page (PDP) that plays a product video. The A/B test compares a PDP without the play button (control) against a PDP with it (variant). It was built as a Sectionfy.io section named 'CRO | PDP | Video Play Button' and installed in the 'A/B Test (PSY)' theme. The exact placement and visual style of the button are not documented, because no screenshots or code came with the ticket.

why.text: Hypothesis from the ticket: if the PDP offers a product video, conversion rate rises because customers can experience the product better. A video shows fit, material and function in motion, which reduces uncertainty before purchase. This matters most for products that are hard to judge from still images, such as jewelry like the tested bracelet. Video lets shoppers see size, drape and sparkle, which lowers perceived risk and return anxiety.

how.text: 1) Add the Sectionfy.io 'Video Play Button' section to the PDP template in a duplicated test theme. 2) Upload the product video and a matching poster image. 3) Replace the placeholder video and image with real product assets before launch. 4) Create the experiment in Ablyft with the control PDP (no button) and the variant PDP (with button). 5) Check in the first days that the KPIs are tracked correctly. 6) If the test wins, move the changes into the live theme.

items: Video source or file per product
Play button position and style (assumed — not documented)
Product or template the section is assigned to
Ablyft experiment targeting for the variant

dependencies.text: Sectionfy.io section library and a theme that can host it (here, a dedicated 'A/B Test (PSY)' theme). The A/B tool is Ablyft, with its script already in the theme and the customer account set up. Real product video and image assets are required, since the test ran with a placeholder. Metafield use is unknown (not stated).

items: Bounce rate and time on PDP
